docs.title: NVD · CVE-2026-82907 · CVSS 9.8
docs.text:
Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay in ExternalLoginKeysManager in Apache OFBiz 24.09 before 24.09.08 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker who captures a live externalLoginKey value to obtain a complete, cookie-free, reusable session as the user who issued it, in every webapp that user can reach, because checkExternalLoginKey runs as a global preprocessor ahead of both the CSRF and authentication checks and accepts the key as a bearer credential that is never bound to a client, never expires, and is not invalidated after use, while the framework itself both appends live keys to every cross-webapp link it renders and, via WidgetWorker's unvalidated inter-app link target, lets an authenticated user's key be attached to an attacker-chosen absolute URL and delivered directly to the attacker's own server. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 24.09.08, which fixes this issue.
영향: Apache Software Foundation Apache OFBiz 24.09.08 미만
참고: https://lists.apache.org/thread.html/7b2syzksp7klt9fvhdg0olldvs2g83lz

docs.title: NVD · CVE-2026-83542 · CVSS 9.8
docs.text:
Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') in Apache OFBiz 24.09 before 24.09.08 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server by staging crafted widget XML in a multipart upload and overriding the mainDecoratorLocation used by a manager login route through an anonymous JSON request, causing OFBiz to load the staged XML through its live screen descriptor mechanism and evaluate an unsandboxed Groovy expression while rendering the authentication-failure page. Further validation established the following:

-- The exploit does not require a malformed or incomplete multipart body: a well-formed multipart request that is kept in flight and then allowed to complete normally is sufficient.

-- The screen loader reads the widget XML from a live process file descriptor while the upload is streaming, rather than from any file the attacker persists to disk.

-- The same underlying issue is also reachable through the public, explicitly unauthenticated /sfa/control/editPortalPageColumnWidth route, returning command output directly in an HTTP 200 response — it is not limited to the login-failure rendering path used in the original report.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 24.09.08, which fixes this issue.
영향: Apache Software Foundation Apache OFBiz 24.09.08 미만
참고: https://lists.apache.org/thread.html/7b2syzksp7klt9fvhdg0olldvs2g83lz

docs.title: NVD · CVE-2026-84183 · CVSS 8.8
docs.text:
Incorrect Authorization in the updateLayout simple-method in applications/content/minilang/layout/LayoutEvents.xml in Apache OFBiz 24.09 before 24.09.08 on all platforms allows a remote authenticated attacker holding only OFBTOOLS_VIEW and CONTENTMGR_VIEW to execute arbitrary commands as the OFBiz process user, by using updateLayout's authorization check — which validates only the fixed CONTENT_CREATE operation rather than an update permission on the actual Content record and an independently selected DataResource — to relink an existing RESPONSE-purpose Content record and convert an arbitrary, independently selected DataResource into an OFBIZ_FILE/FTL resource pointed at the OFBiz access log, poisoned via a crafted User-Agent header and evaluated through the normal authenticated showContent route. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 24.09.08, which fixes this issue.

docs.title: NVD · CVE-2026-109220 · CVSS 9.8
docs.text:
The PDF Invoice for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.1 via the 'customer_note' parameter parameter. This is due to insufficient sanitization of the customer_note checkout field, which is inlined verbatim into invoice HTML, entity-decoded back into a live tag by simplehtmldom, reassembled into raw bytes by mPDF, and passed to unserialize() in _getObjAttr without validation. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server. An unauthenticated attacker can trigger the vulnerable code path on a default install by placing an anonymous WooCommerce checkout via the public Store API (POST /wc/store/v1/checkout) using a Direct Bank Transfer or cheque payment method, which automatically transitions the order to 'on-hold' status and fires the plugin's invoice-generation hook.

docs.text:
The Project Manager – AI Powered Project Management, Task Management, Kanban Board & Time Tracker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.1 via the 'id' parameter parameter. This is due to unsanitized 'id' parameter value concatenated directly into the pipe-delimited validation rule string, which is then split and each token invoked as a dynamic PHP function with no allowlist check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server. This is exploitable by unauthenticated attackers because WordPress core executes the route argument's validate_callback inside WP_REST_Server::dispatch() before the route's permission_callback is invoked, meaning the Project_Manage_Capability authorization gate is never reached on the vulnerable code path.

docs.title: Synology NAS 대상 랜섬웨어 공격 주의 권고
docs.text:
□ 개요
○ 최근 Synology NAS를 대상으로 한 랜섬웨어 공격으로 저장된 파일이 암호화되는 피해가 발생하고 있어 사용자 주의 필요
○ 피해 예방을 위해 기존 보호나라 「Synology 제품 보안 업데이트 권고」에 따른 Synology 보안 업데이트 적용 및 아래 보안 조치 이행 권고
□ 감염 의심 징후
○ NAS에 저장된 파일이 갑자기 열리지 않거나 파일명·확장자가 비정상적으로 변경*되고 파일 복구를 대가로 금전을 요구하는 안내문 등이 나타남
* L0CK3D, locked, lock3d, lock3D 등의 유사하지만 다양한 형태의 확장자로 변경되는 사례 발생
□ 예방 및 보안 조치
○ (보안 업데이트) 감염 징후가 없는 장비는 제조사 안내에 따라 해당 모델에서 지원하는 최신 DSM 및 설치 패키지로 업데이트

○ (외부 접근 제한) NAS 관리화면의 인터넷 직접 노출을 최소화하고, 불필요한 포트포워딩·원격접속·서비스 비활성화
- 원격접속이 필요한 경우 VPN 등 통제된 접속 경로를 사용하고, 방화벽을 통해 접속 허용 대상·서비스 제한
○ (계정 보호) 기본 관리자 계정 비활성화, 다른 서비스와 구분되는 강력한 비밀번호 사용 및 다중인증 설정

□ 감염 의심 시 대응 방법
○ (즉시 격리) 파일 암호화·랜섬노트 등 감염 징후 발견 시 NAS의 네트워크 연결을 차단하고, 연결된 동기화·백업 작업 중단
